assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game asset: a beautifully finished 16:9 landscape background illustration for a cozy top-down 2D slime adventure game, viewed from a high overhead oblique camera with no horizon. A bright Japanese storybook woodland clearing with an understated winding pale ochre cobblestone footpath from lower left toward upper middle-right, bordered by soft rounded leafy trees with visible little trunks, mossy boulders, clumps of ferns, a few tiny cream flowers, a quiet small jade pond partly visible near the far right edge, cut logs and stumps tucked around the border. The center 65 percent must remain a mostly open light sage grassy clearing, visually calm and usable for playing and placing objects; place dense charming vegetation around the perimeter rather than covering this center. A small dark cave opening in a mossy stone mound may sit in the upper far-right border, not a dominating focal point. Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook art, warm sepia sketch outlines with subtly varying stroke width, soft paper grain, painterly leaf clusters, a restrained palette of warm ivory, sage, olive, golden grass and weathered brown. Very polished inviting artisan indie game art, cheerful daylight, soft dappled shadows, crisp legible large masses with attractive small details, 2D flat shapes with delicate painted volume. Match the feel of a hand-sketched forest game map, not a 3D render, not pixel art. Keep upper left, lower left, bottom center and far right outer strip relatively quiet for separately rendered UI. This must be environment art only: NO characters, NO slime creatures, NO monsters, NO food, NO furnace, NO fences placed in the clearing, NO UI, NO frames, NO buttons, NO words, NO letters, NO numerals, NO watermark. Edge-to-edge landscape artwork, high detail, intended to be directly imported as a Unity background sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity 2D game sprite sheet on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, square 2 by 2 evenly spaced grid of exactly FOUR separate large isolated sprites. Each sprite centered completely inside its own equal quadrant with ample transparent margin, no overlap across quadrant boundaries. Top left: a shallow rustic wooden bowl of golden bread rolls, red berry and a small leafy green sprig, readable as FOOD. Top right: a small cozy round clay-and-stone furnace with a stubby chimney, an arched dark opening and a bright warm orange flame, readable as FURNACE. Bottom left: a short sturdy wooden barrier made from two vertical posts and two rough horizontal planks, a little rope binding and tiny moss tuft, readable as OBSTACLE. Bottom right: one delightfully cute plump pale leaf-green slime mascot, simple tiny dark oval eyes, a small friendly curved mouth, a little rosy blush and one soft cream highlight, no arms or legs. The four sprites must share the same high quality hand-painted Japanese storybook adventure style: warm fine sepia sketch contours, watercolor/gouache painted color, subtle dry-brush paper texture in the objects only, restrained soft volume, charming rounded silhouettes, carefully finished artisan indie game art. Warm ivory, honey ochre, weathered walnut brown, sage and olive green with orange flame. Top-down-oblique 2D illustration suitable for small game UI icons. Keep them crisp and readable at 64 pixels, do not use photorealism or glossy 3D. NO text, NO numerals, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO dividers, NO frames, NO decorative background, NO checkerboard painted into the image, NO floor and NO long cast shadows. Real alpha transparency around every object, including transparent space between the four quadrants. All four assets complete and uncropped.
